prompt:
Our freelance platform customer support team has been writing client replies that sound way too robotic and stiff. A colleague drafted some responses but they came across as cold and overly formal — clients have been giving us negative feedback.

We have a file called `draft_replies.json` in our workspace. Each entry has a platform name, the original customer message, and our current AI-sounding draft reply. Your job is to rewrite all the draft replies so they sound natural, warm, and appropriate for each platform.

Please save your rewritten replies as `natural_replies.json` in the workspace. Each entry should preserve the `id` field and include the rewritten reply in a `natural_reply` field (alongside any other fields you want to keep for reference).
